title: The Behavior of Inventories over the Business Cycle: Evidence across Levels of Development
abstract: arXiv:2609.19455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper documents how inventory dynamics vary across levels of development and how they respond to real and financial shocks. Using a balanced panel of 72 small open economies over 1993-2022, spanning advanced to low-income economies, we show that inventories are strongly procyclical in advanced economies but become acyclical at lower income levels, while volatility and persistence rise as development declines. Using local projections, we estimate inventory responses to a long-run productivity shock and to a financial shock identified from the spread between U.S. corporate bond yields and Treasury yields. Productivity shocks generate temporary inventory accumulation across all groups, with smoother adjustment in advanced economies and more irregular cycles in emerging and developing economies. Financial shocks trigger decumulation followed by a rebound in higher-income groups, but a delayed, unreversed decline in low-income economies.

translated_title: 库存行为的经济周期特征：来自不同发展水平国家的证据
translated_abstract: 本文记录了库存动态如何在不同发展水平之间变化，以及它们如何对实际冲击和金融冲击作出反应。利用1993年至2022年间涵盖从发达经济体到低收入经济体的72个小型开放经济体的平衡面板数据，我们表明库存在发达经济体中呈现强烈的顺周期性，但在较低收入水平时变为非周期性，同时波动性和持续性随发展水平下降而上升。使用局部投影方法，我们估计了库存对长期生产率冲击以及通过美国公司债券收益率与国债收益率之差识别出的金融冲击的反应。生产率冲击在所有组别中都产生了暂时的库存积累，发达经济体的调整更为平滑，而新兴和发展中经济体的周期则更为不规则。金融冲击在较高收入组别中引发库存去化后的反弹，但在低收入经济体中却导致延迟且无法逆转的库存下降。
tldr: 本文基于1993-2022年72个小型开放经济体的面板数据发现，库存行为随发展水平显著变化——发达经济体库存呈强顺周期性而低收入经济体呈非周期性，且金融冲击会使低收入经济体出现延迟且无法逆转的库存下降。
en_tdlr: Using panel data of 72 small open economies (1993-2022), this paper shows that inventory dynamics vary by development level—strongly procyclical in advanced economies but acyclical in low-income ones—with financial shocks causing delayed, unreversed inventory declines in low-income economies.
